title: Three Springs and One Short Stone
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：frog　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 frog 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 my uncle ① caught a frog that no keeper in the pond would have counted, and he said the catching was the whole of the spring. The ② frog, meaning the creature itself and not the sound, ran three springs and stayed uncounted in the book; a frog, he said, is the only thing in a pond that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ frog in that pond had the same short stone beside it, and the ④ frog at the far bank, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A frog, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; my uncle said the counting is the part that fills three springs.

My aunt meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the frog was the whole of the matter, meaning the hoarseness and not the creature. The ⑥ frog, meaning the hoarseness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; frog, she said, is either something you catch or the only word that means both a creature and a hoarseness. She said the hoarseness is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ frog had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short stone. The ⑧ frog of the whole thing, my uncle wrote in April, was one pond and three springs of counting; frog, he said, is either the one at the far bank or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ frog I remember is the one counted in the plan, which closed in 1973 and is still described as the quietest in the pond. A ⑩ frog, my mother said in 1975, is the only one that improves by being counted; every frog, she said, is a hoarseness that has agreed to look like a creature. She said the hoarseness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 蛙；青蛙（指池塘里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 青蛙（指那一只本身，与蛙鸣相对）
C. 固定搭配：catch a frog 捉一只青蛙
D. n. 青蛙（指留给孩子们的那一只）
E. n. 青蛙（抽象总称，指一方池塘的捉蛙之事）
F. n. 青蛙（指计划里写到、被数过的那一只）
G. n. （喉咙的）嘶哑（a frog in the throat，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 嘶哑（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

items.q: caught a frog that no keeper in the pond would have counted
The frog, meaning the creature itself and not the sound
the frog at the far bank
the frog was the whole of the matter
the frog had become a line in a plan
The frog of the whole thing
A frog, my mother said in 1975

answers.why: catch a frog 意为“捉一只青蛙”，1964 年叔叔捉了一只池塘里没有一位看守人肯数过的青蛙。
frog 意为“青蛙”，指那一只本身而不是蛙鸣，它经过了三个春天而在簿子上没有被数过。
frog 意为“青蛙”，指池塘里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一块矮矮的石头。
frog 意为“青蛙”，指留给孩子们的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
frog 意为“喉咙的嘶哑”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，姑姑说这阵嘶哑就是那件事的全部。
frog 意为“嘶哑”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那只青蛙，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
frog 意为“青蛙”，指计划里写到、被数过的那一只，到 1971 年这一只成了计划里的一行。
frog 意为“青蛙”，叔叔四月写道，整件事的捉蛙之事是一方池塘和三个春天的数过。
frog 意为“青蛙”，我记得的是计划里数过的那一只，1973 年结束了，至今仍被说成池塘里最安静的一只。
frog 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，一只青蛙是唯一会因为被好好数过而变得更好的东西。
